articles.headline: City expands weekend bike lanes along the river
articles.headlineZh: 本市沿河增设周末自行车道
articles.dek: Officials say the pilot will run through spring before a wider rollout.

body.en: The city will open new bike lanes along the river this weekend.
body.zh: 本市将于本周末沿河开放新的自行车道。
body.noteZh: will open = 将要开放；along the river = 沿着河。

body.en: Local riders hope the pilot becomes a permanent route.
body.zh: 当地骑行者希望这次试点能变成永久路线。

body.en: Shops near the path expect more visitors on sunny days.
body.zh: 小路附近的店铺预计晴天会迎来更多访客。
body.noteZh: expect = 预计；on sunny days = 在晴天。
